verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 7.73
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 7.73

verses.pali: 7. Mahāvagga
verses.english: 7. The Great Chapter

verses.pali: Sunettasutta
verses.english: About Sunetta

verses.pali: “Bhūtapubbaṁ, bhikkhave, sunetto nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
verses.english: “Once upon a time, mendicants, there was a Teacher named Sunetta. He was a religious founder and was free of desire for sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Sunettassa kho pana, bhikkhave, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṁ.
verses.english: He had many hundreds of disciples.

verses.pali: Sunetto satthā sāvakānaṁ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desesi.
verses.english: He taught them the path to rebirth in the company of Divinity.

verses.pali: Ye kho pana, bhikkhave, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desentassa cittāni nappasādesuṁ te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjiṁsu.
verses.english: Those lacking confidence in Sunetta were—when their body broke up, after death—reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Ye kho pana, bhikkhave, sunettassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṁ te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjiṁsu.
verses.english: Those full of confidence in Sunetta were—when their body broke up, after death—reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Bhūtapubbaṁ, bhikkhave, mūgapakkho nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
verses.english: Once upon a time there was a teacher named Mūgapakkha …

verses.pali: aranemi nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
verses.english: Aranemi …

verses.pali: kuddālako nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
verses.english: Kuddālaka …

verses.pali: hatthipālo nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
verses.english: Hatthipāla …

verses.pali: jotipālo nāma satthā ahosi …pe…
verses.english: Jotipāla …

verses.pali: arako nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
verses.english: Araka. He was a religious founder and was free of desire for sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Arakassa kho pana, bhikkhave, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṁ.
verses.english: He had many hundreds of disciples.

verses.pali: Arako nāma satthā sāvakānaṁ brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desesi.
verses.english: He taught them the way to rebirth in the company of Divinity.

verses.pali: Ye kho pana, bhikkhave, arakassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desentassa cittāni nappasādesuṁ, te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjiṁsu.
verses.english: Those lacking confidence in Araka were—when their body broke up, after death—reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Ye kho pana, bhikkhave, arakassa satthuno brahmalokasahabyatāya dhammaṁ desentassa cittāni pasādesuṁ, te kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjiṁsu.
verses.english: Those full of confidence in Araka were—when their body broke up, after death—reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Taṁ kiṁ maññatha, bhikkhave,
verses.english: What do you think, mendicants?

verses.pali: yo ime satta satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṁ so apuññaṁ pasaveyyā”ti?
verses.english: If someone with malicious intent were to abuse and insult these seven teachers with their hundreds of followers, would they not brim with much wickedness?”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “Yes, sir.”

verses.pali: “Yo, bhikkhave, ime satta satthāre titthakare kāmesu vītarāge anekasataparivāre sasāvakasaṅghe paduṭṭhacitto akkoseyya paribhāseyya, bahuṁ so apuññaṁ pasaveyya.
verses.english: “They would indeed.

verses.pali: Yo ekaṁ diṭṭhisampannaṁ puggalaṁ paduṭṭhacitto akkosati paribhāsati, ayaṁ tato bahutaraṁ apuññaṁ pasavati.
verses.english: But someone who abuses and insults a single individual accomplished in view with malicious intent brims even more with wickedness.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, ito bahiddhā evarūpiṁ khantiṁ vadāmi yathāmaṁ sabrahmacārīsu.
verses.english: I say that any injury done by those outside of the Buddhist community does not compare with what is done to one’s own spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, evaṁ sikkhitabbaṁ:
verses.english: So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘na no sabrahmacārīsu cittāni paduṭṭhāni bhavissantī’ti.
verses.english: ‘We will have no malicious intent for our spiritual companions.’

verses.pali: Evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban”ti.
verses.english: That’s how you should train.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
